VRChat Environment Variables

Download Raw CSV
Name Type Description & Notes Default Pattern
PROTON_LOG switch Enables Proton/Wine full debug log output written to ~/steam-438100.log

Useful for diagnosing Proton/VRChat launch failures. Creates large log files. Source: ProtonPlus
PROTON_LOG_DIR string Overrides the directory where Proton log files are written

e.g. PROTON_LOG_DIR=/tmp — prevents log clutter in home directory		 %HOME% ^/.+$
PROTON_ENABLE_NVAPI switch Enables NVIDIA NVAPI DLL emulation for DLSS and NVIDIA-specific features (e.g. Reflex).

Source: ProtonPlus
PROTON_ENABLE_NGX_UPDATER switch Updates DLSS components for supported games via NVIDIA NGX

Source: ProtonPlus
PROTON_DLSS_INDICATOR switch Shows an in-game DLSS status indicator

Source: ProtonPlus
PROTON_NVIDIA_LIBS switch Enables NVIDIA-specific proprietary libraries inside Proton

Source: ProtonPlus
PROTON_HIDE_NVIDIA_GPU switch Reports NVIDIA GPU as AMD for affected games (e.g. Reflex workaround)

Source: ProtonPlus. Aligns with PROTON_HIDE_APU for AMD
PROTON_HIDE_APU switch Hides AMD APU from the game — use when the APU interferes with dGPU selection

Source: ProtonPlus
PROTON_ENABLE_D9VK switch Enables D9VK (Vulkan-based Direct3D 9) renderer instead of DXVK

Experimental; try if D3D9 games have issues under DXVK
PROTON_USE_WINED3D switch Forces OpenGL (WineD3D) fallback instead of DXVK for Direct3D 9-11

Source: ProtonPlus; use when DXVK causes crashes
PROTON_USE_D7VK switch Enables D7VK for older Direct3D 7 and 8 era games

Source: ProtonPlus; requires a compatible Proton version
PROTON_USE_NTSYNC switch Set to 0 to use FSync instead of NTSync for sync-sensitive games

Source: ProtonPlus; NTSync is default in modern Proton		 1 ^[01]$
PROTON_FORCE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE switch Forces 4GB address space support for 32-bit process (LAA flag)

Source: ProtonPlus; helps prevent OOM crashes in memory-intensive content
PROTON_USE_WOW64 switch Enables WoW64 support for 32-bit games on 64-bit Proton builds

Source: ProtonPlus
PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND switch Runs the game on native Wayland instead of XWayland

Source: ProtonPlus
PROTON_PREFER_SDL switch Workaround for controller detection issues — prefers SDL input over DirectInput

Source: ProtonPlus
PROTON_NO_STEAMINPUT switch Disables Steam Input support entirely

Source: ProtonPlus
PROTON_DISCORD_BRIDGE switch Enables Proton's Discord presence bridge for rich presence in native Linux Discord

Source: ProtonPlus; requires Proton 11-1 or newer
PROTON_USE_OPTISCALER switch Enables Proton OptiScaler integration for DLSS/FSR/XeSS upscaling substitution

Source: ProtonPlus; requires Proton 11-1 or newer
PROTON_FSR4_UPGRADE switch Upgrades supported FSR 3.1 games to FSR 4 via the selected custom Proton build

Source: ProtonPlus; requires Proton-GE/Proton-CachyOS/Proton-EM and compatible AMD GPU
PROTON_FSR4_RDNA3_UPGRADE switch Legacy RDNA3-specific FSR 4 upgrade switch retained by older Proton-GE builds

Source: ProtonPlus; prefer PROTON_FSR4_UPGRADE on newer builds
PROTON_MLFG_UPGRADE switch Requests ML frame generation (FSR 4 MLFG) in supported custom Proton builds

Source: ProtonPlus; requires FSR 4.0.3+ and compatible AMD hardware
PROTON_FORCE_NVAPI switch Forces Proton's NVAPI path — AMD Reflex last-resort fallback that can break FSR 4

Source: ProtonPlus; use only after safer Reflex presets fail
PROTON_XESS_UPGRADE switch Updates XeSS components in supported Intel-XeSS games

Source: ProtonPlus
PROTON_DXVK_LOWLATENCY switch Enables Proton-CachyOS DXVK low-latency path for Direct3D 9-11

Source: ProtonPlus; requires Proton-CachyOS build
PROTON_VKD3D_LOWLATENCY switch Enables VKD3D-Proton low latency for Direct3D 12 games with Reflex markers

Source: ProtonPlus; requires Proton-CachyOS; incompatible with frame gen
PROTON_USE_SECCOMP switch Enables seccomp-based syscall sandboxing for Proton processes

Disable (set 0) if game crashes immediately on launch
WINEDEBUG string Wine debug channel configuration — comma-separated channel:level pairs

e.g. WINEDEBUG=-all,+openxr — use vrclient for VRChat-specific Wine logs		 -all ^([+-]?[a-zA-Z_*]+(?:,[+-]?[a-zA-Z_*]+)*)$
WINEDLLOVERRIDES string Wine DLL override map in format dllname=type (n=native b=builtin)

Separate multiple with semicolons. iyuv_32= fixes video codec issues in VRChat		 iyuv_32= ^([A-Za-z0-9_*.]+=[nNbB,]*)(;[A-Za-z0-9_*.]+=[nNbB,]*)*$
WINEPREFIX string Overrides the Wine prefix directory path for this game session

Usually not needed — Steam sets this automatically for Proton games		 /run/media/system/Data/Games/Steam/steamapps/compatdata/438100/pfx ^/.+$
WINE_SIMULATE_WRITECOPY switch Simulates page write-copy protection — fixes certain game initialization errors

Source: ProtonPlus
WINE_VK_USE_SYNC2 switch Enables Vulkan synchronization 2 extension in Wine/Proton Vulkan layer

Source: ProtonPlus
WINE_SYNC_USE_FUTEX_WAITV switch Enables futex_waitv kernel syscall for synchronization — reduces CPU overhead

Source: ProtonPlus
PULSE_LATENCY_MSEC int Sets PulseAudio latency target in milliseconds

Source: ProtonPlus; lower = less latency but more risk of audio glitches		 60 ^\d{1,3}$
WINEALSA_CHANNELS int Sets Wine ALSA output channel count

Source: ProtonPlus; requires Proton 11-1 or newer		 2 ^[1-8]$
WINEALSA_SPACIAL switch Enables Wine ALSA spatial downmix for 4/6/8 channel configurations

Source: ProtonPlus; requires 4+ output channels via WINEALSA_CHANNELS
PRESSURE_VESSEL_IMPORT_OPENXR_1_RUNTIMES switch Exposes host machine OpenXR runtime JSON files inside the Steam container

Source: community; needed for WiVRn/Monado/other host OpenXR runtimes
PRESSURE_VESSEL_FILESYSTEMS_RW string Grants read-write access to specific host paths inside the pressure-vessel container

Colon-separated absolute paths. e.g. /var/lib/flatpak/app/io.github.wivrn.wivrn		 ^(/.+)(:.+)*$
DRI_PRIME switch Forces the game to run on the AMD discrete GPU on hybrid graphics systems

Source: ProtonPlus; set to 1 to use dGPU
AMD_ICD string Chooses the AMD Vulkan ICD — RADV (Mesa) or AMDVLK (AMD official)

Source: ProtonPlus; RADV is generally preferred for gaming		 RADV ^(RADV|AMDVLK)$
STAGING_SHARED_MEMORY switch Enables AMD driver shared memory staging support — improves VRAM bandwidth

Source: ProtonPlus; AMD only
mesa_glthread string Controls Mesa GL threading — improves multi-threaded OpenGL performance

Source: ProtonPlus; lowercase var name		 true ^(true|false)$
MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DISABLE switch Controls Mesa's on-disk shader cache — set 0 to enable / 1 to disable

Source: ProtonPlus; 0=cache enabled (default), 1=disabled		 0 ^[01]$
ENABLE_LAYER_MESA_ANTI_LAG switch Enables Mesa Anti-Lag to reduce input latency on supported AMD setups

Source: ProtonPlus; AMD Mesa only
RADV_PERFTEST string Enables experimental RADV features: comma-separated flags (rt,sam,nggc,gpl,ruse,emulate_rt)

Source: ProtonPlus. rt=ray tracing,sam=Resizable BAR,nggc=NGG culling,gpl=GPL shaders,ruse=userspace queue,emulate_rt=SW ray tracing		 ^(rt|sam|nggc|gpl|ruse|emulate_rt)(,(rt|sam|nggc|gpl|ruse|emulate_rt))*$
RADV_DEBUG string Enables RADV debug/workaround flags: comma-separated (nocng,noabin,nobg,nodcc,novrs,nogpl,noexecbuf2,precompile,noatc)

Source: ProtonPlus. nocng=no NGG,nodcc=no DCC,novrs=no VRS,precompile=precompile shaders,noatc=fixes APU texture issues		 ^([a-z0-9]+)(,[a-z0-9]+)*$
ACO_DEBUG string Enables AMD ACO shader compiler debug flags: comma-separated (validate,nofpgather,perfinfo,force-isel,nosched,nowave32)

Source: ProtonPlus; AMD ACO compiler only		 ^([a-z0-9\-]+)(,[a-z0-9\-]+)*$
DXIL_SPIRV_CONFIG string Configures DXIL-SPIR-V translation behavior — e.g. RDNA3 MLFG workaround

Source: ProtonPlus; e.g. wmma_rdna3_workaround for RDNA3 MLFG		 ^[a-z0-9_]+(=[a-z0-9_]+)?(,[a-z0-9_]+(=[a-z0-9_]+)?)*$
LOW_LATENCY_LAYER switch Enables Proton-CachyOS low-latency Vulkan layer with VK_AMD_anti_lag exposure

Source: ProtonPlus; requires compatible game and CachyOS build
LOW_LATENCY_LAYER_REFLEX switch Switches CachyOS low-latency layer from Anti-Lag to VK_NV_low_latency2 (NVIDIA Reflex)

Source: ProtonPlus; requires LOW_LATENCY_LAYER and game Reflex support
LOW_LATENCY_LAYER_SPOOF_NVIDIA switch Makes the low-latency Vulkan layer report an NVIDIA GPU — last-resort Reflex workaround

Source: ProtonPlus; can break FSR 4 — use only when all else fails
DXVK_NVAPI_ALLOW_OTHER_DRIVERS switch Allows DXVK-NVAPI on non-NVIDIA drivers — least-invasive AMD Reflex compatibility preset

Source: ProtonPlus
DXVK_NVAPI_VKREFLEX switch Enables CachyOS NVIDIA Reflex Vulkan layer for native Vulkan games

Source: ProtonPlus; requires NVIDIA and compatible CachyOS build
DXVK_CONFIG string Configures DXVK behavior — e.g. dxgi.hideAmdGpu=True to hide AMD GPU

Source: ProtonPlus; e.g. dxgi.hideAmdGpu=True for Reflex GPU spoof		 ^[a-zA-Z.]+=[A-Za-z0-9_]+$
DXVK_NVAPI switch Enables DXVK-NVAPI. Use PROTON_ENABLE_NVAPI instead when using Proton

Standalone DXVK installations
DXVK_HUD string Shows DXVK Vulkan overlay with GPU/frame timing stats

Combine with commas: DXVK_HUD=fps,gpus,memory — useful for performance profiling		 0 ^(0|1|(fps|gpus|compiler|memory|frametimes|full)(,(fps|gpus|compiler|memory|frametimes|full))*)$
DXVK_ASYNC switch Enables asynchronous shader compilation in DXVK to reduce stutter

Source: ProtonPlus; may cause visual artifacts during shader warmup — requires patched DXVK
DXVK_FRAME_RATE int Caps DXVK frame rate to specified value (frames per second — 0=uncapped)

Source: ProtonPlus; overrides in-game frame limiter via Vulkan layer		 0 ^\d+$
DXVK_LOG_LEVEL string Controls DXVK logging verbosity

Source: ProtonPlus. none=silent,error=critical only,debug=verbose		 none ^(none|error|warn|info|debug)$
DXVK_STATE_CACHE switch Enables DXVK pipeline state cache for faster shader reuse between sessions

Disable if you have persistent shader bugs after game updates
VKD3D_CONFIG string Configures VKD3D-Proton behavior — comma-separated flags (shader_cache,force_host_cache,upload_hvv,no_upload_hvv,nodxr,dxr11,dxr10,gpuva,stable_power_state,...)

Source: ProtonPlus. nodxr=disable RT,dxr11=enable RT,shader_cache=disk cache,upload_hvv=ReBAR staging,gpuva=GPU VA		 ^[a-z_]+(,[a-z_]+)*$
VKD3D_LOG_LEVEL string Controls VKD3D logging verbosity

Source: ProtonPlus. none=muted,err=critical,warn=warnings,fixme=missing features,info=general,trace=verbose		 ^(none|err|warn|fixme|info|trace)$
VKD3D_SHADER_CACHE switch Enables VKD3D-Proton internal on-disk shader cache to reduce stuttering

Source: ProtonPlus
VKD3D_GPUVA switch Enables GPU Virtual Addressing in VKD3D-Proton — helps open-world games with D3D12 memory

Source: ProtonPlus
SCB_AUTO_VRR switch ScopeBuddy: Enables automatic Variable Refresh Rate matching to game FPS

Source: ProtonPlus; requires ScopeBuddy wrapper
MANGOHUD switch Enables MangoHUD performance overlay (Vulkan env mode — see also gamemoderun wrapper)

Source: ProtonPlus; install mangohud separately; use MANGOHUD=1
MANGOHUD_CONFIG string Configures MangoHUD overlay display options (comma-separated)

e.g. fps,gpu_stats,cpu_stats,ram		 ^[a-z_]+(=[^,]*)?(,[a-z_]+(=[^,]*)?)*$
ENABLE_VKBASALT switch Enables vkBasalt post-processing layer (sharpening/color grading) on top of VRChat

Install vkbasalt; configure via /etc/vkBasalt.conf or VKBASALT_CONFIG_FILE
VK_ICD_FILENAMES string Specifies path to specific Vulkan ICD driver JSON file (overrides default GPU)

e.g. /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/nvidia_icd.json — use to force specific GPU		 ^/.+\.json(:.+\.json)*$
VK_DRIVER_FILES string Alternative to VK_ICD_FILENAMES — specifies Vulkan driver JSON files

e.g. /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/radeon_icd.x86_64.json		 ^/.+\.json(:.+\.json)*$
MESA_VK_WSI_PRESENT_MODE string Overrides Vulkan window surface present mode (vsync behavior)

mailbox=low-latency,immediate=no-vsync,fifo=vsync		 ^(mailbox|immediate|fifo|fifo_relaxed)$
